message.name: AccountExcludedMandateMaintenanceAmendmentRequestV05
message.definition: The AccountExcludedMandateMaintenanceAmendmentRequest message is sent from an organisation to a financial institution as part of the account maintenance process. It is sent in response to a request from the financial institution to send additional information. Usage: this update is about account details excluding any mandate information. |If modification codes are not used: the organisation will specify under the “Account” and “Organisation” tags the complete information as it should be in the financial institution’s records after processing the update request. |If modification codes are used (in that case, they must be used everywhere): the organisation will specify under the “Account” and “Organisation” tags which elements must be added, deleted, modified, or if they are unchanged.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.
